claim: As of mid-2026 NixOS unstable, nixos-rebuild switch DOES restart systemd user units other than nixos-activation.service — a behaviour change introduced via the switch-to-configuration-ng Rust rewrite that replaced the old reload-only handling.
stance_target: gap-03 target position that 'nixos-rebuild switch does not restart systemd user services for lingered/not-logged-in users' remains true on 2026 NixOS
scope_conditions: NixOS unstable 26.11 / nixpkgs 26.05 era after 2026-05-26; GNOME and niri sessions; both Linger=yes and Linger=no
quoted_support: Namely, the change was that `nixos-rebuild switch` now restarts user units other than `nixos-activation.service`. Since that change, some user services (`niri.service`, `gnome-session-monitor.service`, there might be more) started restarting on `nixos-rebuild switch` and causing instability

claim: The user-unit restart regression fired first on 2026-05-26, isolating nixpkgs 26.05.20260515.d233902 → 26.05.20260523.64c08a7 with systemd constant at 260.1, implicating PR #517768 commits 6ced06a1b and 76c8d4509 as the trigger.
stance_target: gap-03: that the restart behaviour is unchanged since the Feb 2023 Discourse evidence chain
scope_conditions: flake/channel updates where a unit's store path changes; not small config edits
quoted_support: The switch that first did it moved nixpkgs `26.05.20260515.d233902` → `26.05.20260523.64c08a7`. systemd is 260.1 on both sides, so it isn't a systemd bump. The only commits in that range touching the relevant code are from #517768

claim: When a restarted user unit collapses the graphical session, switch-to-configuration-ng loses its stdout pipe and exits 101 (Rust panic exit code), aborting activation mid-way and leaving system services like docker, home-assistant and NetworkManager stopped — a half-applied generation worse than the logout itself.
stance_target: fleet-reliability risk assessment of running agents as user units on NixOS (relevant to ha-linux-agent architecture)
scope_conditions: switch launched from a terminal inside the affected session; avoidable by running switch from TTY or SSH
quoted_support: switch-to-configuration-ng loses its stdout pipe and exits 101 — the Rust panic exit code — so activation aborts partway through and leaves behind whatever it had already stopped. On my last occurrence that was docker, home-assistant and NetworkManager, none of which came back.

claim: The session teardown occurs with Linger=no and independently of the systemd-logind GPF reported by the OP, meaning the user-unit restart pass is not gated on lingering at all.
stance_target: gap-03: that the restart question is specifically about lingered users (it affects all user managers that are running)
scope_conditions: GNOME 50, mutter 50.4, GDM autologin, home-manager as NixOS module
quoted_support: I get the same "kicked out to GDM mid-switch" behaviour, but without linger (Linger=no, never set in my config) and without any systemd-logind GPF
